title: Notifications do not show on Garmin
symptom: In the past every time I'd get a new reading I'd get a notification on my Garmin watch. For some reason this has stopped working. I've enabled xdrip+ in the Garmin app and the persistent notification does show in the notification area, but fails to do so on my watch.
evidence_quote: I've enabled xdrip+ in the Garmin app and the persistent notification does show in the notification area, but fails to do so on my watch.
